about_the_game:
Experience a fresh take on tactical turn-based combat that demands careful planning and quick adaptation. Each run is a unique challenge, with customizable characters and a flexible upgrade system. Unlock new skills and hidden content to keep your strategy evolving.




  • Unique Turn-Based/Time-Management Combat - Plan out every second of battle to gain a strategic edge over your opponent. Adapt quickly, as even the best-laid plans can change in an instant!
  • Challenging Roguelike Runs - Embark on ever-changing adventures where no two runs are the same. Navigate strategic map choices where every decision can change your fate.
  • Vast Array of Skills and Upgrades - Choose from a wide variety of class-based active and passive skills. Each party member boasts three unique specializations, allowing you to customize your team and adapt your strategy to your playstyle.
  • Comprehensive Upgrade System - Start with flexible basic skills and evolve your characters after each encounter. Select from a range of new skills and upgrades, creating endless tactical possibilities to overcome the challenges ahead.
  • Unlockable Content - Discover new active and passive skills and other game-changing elements that introduce even more unique, fun, and challenging runs.
